Introduction

  • Clearly state the problem or question you’re addressing.

  • Provide an overview of your approach.

The LASSO, Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selector Operator, regression model has become very popular over the last 30 years. The model was first introduced by Robert Tibshirani to perform variable selection and regularization to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability (Emmert-Streib and Dehmer 2019). Over the years, it has been used to research topics in a numerous amount of fields including biology, computational social sciences, social media, the stock market, economy, political science, robotics, climatology, and pharmacology (Emmert-Streib and Dehmer 2019). In LASSO regression, the prediction error is minimized by identifying the variables and corresponding regression coefficients and then putting constraints on the model which pushes the regression coefficients to zero (Ranstam and Cook 2018). Due to this, this regression model works extremely well with outliers, thus dealing with large-scale problems very efficiently (Roth 2004).

The goal of this analysis, using LASSO regression, is to estimate the survival rate of breast cancer patients. …

LASSO regression can be defined by (Emmert-Streib and Dehmer 2019):

\[ \hat{\beta} = arg \space \min \{\frac{1}{2n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \sum_{j} \beta_j x_{ij})^2 + \lambda||\beta||_1\} \]
